title: Titanium Compressor Casing Segment

The duplex alpha+beta microstructure provides damage tolerance against high-cycle vibration spectra typical of airframe structures. Its fatigue crack growth rate (da/dN ~2×10^-8 m/cycle at ΔK=20 MPa√m) enables safe-life design for Compressor case aft section. faq.q: What corrosion protection is needed for Titanium Compressor Casing Segment in aerospace environments?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V naturally forms a protective TiO₂ passive layer that requires no additional coating for corrosion resistance in standard aerospace environments. For compressor case aft exposed to hydraulic fluids (Skydrol), de-icing fluids, or marine atmosphere, the passive layer is sufficient. However, galvanic isolation from carbon fiber composites (via fiberglass ply or PTFE sleeve) is required to prevent hydrogen embrittlement.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Compressor Casing Segment?
faq.a: Each Titanium Compressor Casing Segment shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for compressor case aft.
